reason: A source-control and GitHub repository panel for DeepSeek Harness that provides Git status, diffs, history, branch and remote management, and user-initiated repository operations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供源代码管理与 GitHub 仓库面板，用于查看 Git 状态、差异、历史记录并执行用户发起的仓库操作。
summaries.en: A source-control and GitHub repository panel for DeepSeek Harness to inspect Git status, diffs, history, and perform user-initiated repository operations.

capabilities: Displays local Git repository status, history, branches, remotes, tags, and stashes
Reads local Git configuration and repository state
Performs user-initiated Git operations including commit, checkout, branch management, merge, rebase, fetch, push, tag, stash, and discard changes
Shows diffs and supports conflict-resolution actions
Opens GitHub repository and comparison pages in a browser
